caption: The drawing depicts a small wooden table with two drawers, rendered in color. The top, sides, and legs of the table are a dark brown wood, while the drawer fronts are a lighter, yellowish-brown wood with a distinct grain pattern. Each drawer has two round, black knobs, totaling four knobs. The legs of the table are turned and feature alternating cylindrical and rounded segments. The table occupies the center of the composition, and its shadow falls to the left and slightly behind, indicating a light source from the right. Surrounding the main image are three smaller, inset line drawings: at the upper left is a rectangle divided into three vertical sections, at the left center are two perspectives of a drawer knob, and at the upper right is a simplified sketch of the table's underside. Scale measurements are provided near each inset drawing, and at the bottom center is the scale of the main drawing (2 1/2" = 1'). The artist’s name, A. Walbeck, is written at the lower right of the image.
title: Dropleaf Table
